title: Action with a Return State
statement: Let $a$ be a one-step action for a machine with state set $S$. Regard it as an action with state set $S\sqcup\{\ast\}$ by retaining its input-head movement, work-tape actions, and output, and replacing its successor state with the original successor when present or with the new state $\ast$ when the original action halts.
hypotheses_covered: A one-step action over state set $S`
